mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not statistically greater than the baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in aggregate demand, which boosts corporate sales and earnings visibility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the risk of corporate earnings deterioration and triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% triggers a market expectation of aggressive monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and increasing risk aversion, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100, coupled with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock combined with weak labor demand, which increases corporate cost pressures and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
